name: OpenPort Security Conformance Profile v0.2
summary: Executable security profile for high-value OpenPort runtime invariants that were previously treated as partial or future validation targets.

checks.description: When resource state changes between preflight/draft creation and execution, execution MUST fail closed with agent.precondition_failed and MUST NOT apply the tool side effect.
evidence: denied audit event with app/key/request/draft correlation

checks.description: Repeating the same (appId, idempotencyKey) execute request 100 times MUST produce exactly one execution effect and return replay responses for duplicates.
evidence: one confirmed draft row for the effect

checks.description: A request rejected with HTTP 429 MUST NOT create a draft, execution, preflight, audit event, or adapter call.
Authenticated allow, deny, and fail paths MUST each emit structured audit events with app, key, actor, status, action, and relevant draft/execution correlation.
evidence: success audit for authenticated read or action
denied audit for policy or precondition denial
failed audit for adapter/tool execution failure
